description: End a contact's Live Activity on every device running it (iOS and Android Live Updates), with its final content state and optionally a dismissal date. Requires email or subscriberId, or broadcast: true to end it on every signed-in device running the activityId. Without dismissalDate iOS keeps it on the Lock Screen and Android in the shade for up to four hours.

activityId.description: Your id for this activity, e.g. "order-1234" (1-128 letters, digits, ".", ":", "-", "_"). Start sets it; update and end target it.

alert.description: Alert shown with the push: title and/or body, plus an optional sound name such as "default".

broadcast.description: true: send to every signed-in device running this activityId, of any contact, e.g. an activity started for a segment, list or tag. Use instead of email/subscriberId (ignored when either is set), never for a per-person id like an order. Needs the campaigns:send scope.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

contentState.description: Final content state. Your Swift ContentState as a JSON object; Android apps receive the same object in their Live Update renderer. Date fields decode as seconds since 2001-01-01 on iOS unless your struct decodes them differently.

dismissalDate.description: When to remove it: Unix seconds or ISO 8601; 0 or a past date removes it now.

email.description: Contact whose activity it is. Provide email or subscriberId, or set broadcast instead.

priority.description: high (default) delivers now and counts against Apple's update budget; low does not count against it. Pushes with an alert always go at high priority.

relevanceScore.description: Orders a person's concurrent activities; higher shows first (0-1000000).

staleDate.description: When iOS shows the activity as out of date: Unix seconds or an ISO 8601 date.

name: end_live_activity

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `end_live_activity` MCP tool.

contactCount.description: Distinct contacts those devices belong to: 0 when nothing was sent, at most 1 for a per-contact call, and the contacts reached for a segment, list, tag or broadcast.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

jobIds.description: Queued delivery job IDs, one per batch.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

platforms.description: tokenCount per platform: {ios, android}. iOS goes through APNs, Android Live Updates through FCM.

tokenCount.description: Devices the push was queued for; 0 means nothing was sent.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
